content: Supabase Auth for Next.js App Router uses @supabase/ssr with three client helpers: a browser client (createBrowserClient) for Client Components, a server client (createServerClient) built per-request in Server Components/Route Handlers/Server Actions reading/writing cookies via the Next.js cookies() API, and middleware that calls an updateSession(request) helper on every request to refresh the auth token cookie before it expires. Middleware must NOT rely on getSession() (not guaranteed to revalidate); use supabase.auth.getUser() which round-trips to the Auth server to validate the token. The auth-helpers package is deprecated in favor of @supabase/ssr.
